front.title: Contact Center Use Cases and Requirements for Agentic Dialogs

abstract.t: Contact centers bring people, AI agents, and business systems into the same voice session. Consumer-controlled agents are also beginning to call agents operated by businesses. This document describes five contact center use cases for the agentic dialog management protocol: a consumer agent calling a business agent, escalation from an AI agent to a human representative, a call that resumes on another channel, a voice dialog passing through speech recognition and synthesis, and a dialog crossing an existing SIP or PSTN network. It derives numbered requirements that can be incorporated into the working group's use cases and requirements document. It also explains how a dialog identifier relates to the conversation records that contact centers already keep.
